# Tetiana Parker
> New Jersey botanical artist (Tetiana Parker LLC) painting original single-wildflower works by hand in Posca acrylic paint marker. Originals only, never prints.

- [Home and collection](https://tetianaparker.com/): current paintings
- [About and FAQ](https://tetianaparker.com/about): who she is, where to buy, prices
- [The Wildflower Commissions](https://tetianaparker.com/commissions): 60x72 in original canvases, $6,800 plus shipping, 15% trade discount, ships in 6 weeks
- [Studies on Etsy](https://tetianaparker.etsy.com): small original studies 8x10 to 18x24, free US shipping
- Wholesale: packs of six 11x14 stretched-canvas originals, $385 per pack on Faire (suggested retail $770) or $300 plus shipping when ordered by email, ships within 10 days; order on Faire: https://tetianaparker.faire.com
- Contact: hello@tetianaparker.com
